sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 330. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 40 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only).
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Status ailment resistance boosted by 30 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 14000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 14000
